name: Branded Screen Printing & Embroidery
old_description: Are you looking for high quality apparel? Check out our most popular garments.
about:
Branded Screen Printing & Embroidery was founded in 2009 in Reno, Nevada. The company is locally owned and operated, and its shop is based on Moana Lane in Reno. From the start, the focus has been on making custom apparel easier for local businesses, schools, teams, and events.

The company provides a range of decoration services entirely in-house, including screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF/UCP) printing, promotional products, vinyl decals, signs and banners, trade show displays, graphic design, jersey sublimation, online company stores, and contract printing. It handles orders from as few as 12 pieces for screen printing up to large bulk runs, with some decoration options carrying no minimum.

Branded serves businesses needing work shirts, polos, jackets, and uniforms; K-12 schools for spirit wear and fundraiser items; youth, adult, and school sports teams for practice gear and fan shirts; nonprofits for volunteer apparel and event gear; festivals, conferences, and community events for staff shirts and giveaways; and construction, trades, and warehouse crews for hi-vis and durable workwear. Customers are primarily in Reno, Sparks, Carson City, and surrounding Northern Nevada, with nationwide shipping available.

The company emphasizes in-house production for quality control and faster communication, a standard turnaround of five to seven business days after proof approval with rush options, low minimums starting at 12 pieces for screen printing, local pickup at the Reno shop, and dedicated Branding Advisors who assist with artwork, apparel selection, and timelines.

name: Bridgelux
old_description: Vertically integrated LED chip maker (epitaxial wafers to light engines)
about:
Bridgelux operates from Fremont, California, where it develops and manufactures LED semiconductor products. The company is led by CEO Yiqun Li, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the available materials.

The company describes itself as a vertically integrated LED chip maker, controlling production from epitaxial wafers through finished light engines. Its product portfolio includes the RGBW Series flagship platform, F90™ technology that aims to deliver high color rendering without sacrificing efficacy, Thrive™ LEDs designed to mimic natural light spectra, and flexible LED strip solutions for architectural and commercial applications. Recent expansions have added high-power outdoor lighting platforms and flexible linear light offerings.

Bridgelux serves the LED lighting industry broadly, with specific focus on architectural, commercial, and outdoor lighting markets. Its components are designed for integration into luminaires and lighting systems where color quality, tunability, and efficacy are specified. The company has announced strategic partnerships, including a patent cross-licensing agreement with Lumitech for next-generation tunable white and RGBW color-mixing technology.

Bridgelux positions its vertical integration as a core differentiator, allowing control over the entire LED production chain from wafer to light engine. The company emphasizes technology that addresses traditional trade-offs, such as the F90™ platform's claim of high CRI without efficacy loss, and Thrive™'s spectral design based on human visual evolution under natural light. These innovations are framed as giving customers a competitive advantage in lighting performance.

name: Bridgeport Insulated Wire Co
old_description: . From magnet wire and Litz wire to military-specification insulations, Bridgeport Insulated Wire delivers the quality and precision your applications demand.
about:
Bridgeport Insulated Wire Co. was established in 1950 in Bridgeport, Connecticut. The company has operated continuously from its original location, producing insulated wire products entirely within the United States.

The company manufactures a range of insulated wire including magnet wire, Litz wire, textile-served wire, and custom bobbin-wound constructions. Its Bridgeport facility houses in-house designed equipment for wire drawing, enameling, twisting, stranding, tinning, bobbin winding, and textile serving, supporting over 12 enamel insulation types from Class 105 to Class 220.

Bridgeport Insulated Wire serves manufacturers in the electrical, aircraft, instrumentation, television, motor, and defense industries. Its products are specified for transformers, solenoids, fractional motors, synchros, relays, aircraft systems, instruments, controls, and military equipment.

The company emphasizes its military and government approvals—including NEMA MW-1000 and Naval JW-1177/A—and its engineering department consults on insulation selection and specification compliance. All manufacturing occurs at the Connecticut plant, which the company says keeps quality high, lead times short, and communication direct.

name: Bright Eye Solar
old_description: As a locally owned solar installer, we handle everything from your first energy audit to system design, permitting, and installation
about:
Bright Eye Solar is a locally owned solar installation company based in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2010 by Jim Noden, who serves as owner and CEO, the firm began as a full-service provider handling energy audits, system design, permitting, and installation for homeowners and businesses across Lancaster County and surrounding regions, as well as Maryland and New Jersey.

The company designs and installs custom solar panel systems for residential and commercial properties, including rooftop and ground‑mounted arrays, and integrates battery storage solutions. It also provides ongoing maintenance and repair services. To date, Bright Eye Solar has completed over 1,600 installations, avoiding approximately 12,000 metric tons of CO₂ annually and saving customers an estimated $2.8 million per year. The operation runs with a team of nine, including a master electrician, project manager, and solar consultants.

Bright Eye Solar serves residential homeowners and commercial businesses throughout Pennsylvania, Maryland, and New Jersey. Its commercial work focuses on helping companies reduce utility bills and improve sustainability, while residential projects aim to lower electric bills and increase energy independence. The company also assists clients with financing options and securing federal, state, and local incentives.

The firm emphasizes its NABCEP certification, transparent proposals, and a proven local track record. It promotes a straightforward installation process, with residential projects typically completed within 30 days after approvals, and highlights its deep local experience as a differentiator in the regional market.

name: Brightstar Solar
old_description: Founded in 2009, we have designed and installed 700+ solar systems.
about:
Brightstar Solar was founded in 2009 by Jonathan and Mona Reese in Marlborough, Massachusetts. The family-owned and operated company began with a vision to provide renewable solar power generation with tangible benefits for customers, the environment, and the country.

The company designs and installs photovoltaic (PV) solar systems for residential and commercial properties across Central and Eastern Massachusetts. Since inception, Brightstar Solar has completed over 700 installations, with project sizes ranging from 10 kW to 23.2 kW. The owners manage the entire process from sales and design through construction, employing crews with hundreds of installations to their credit. They handle permitting, utility interconnection paperwork, and energy credit applications.

Brightstar Solar serves homeowners and businesses in Middlesex, Worcester, Norfolk, Essex, Bristol, and Plymouth counties, including communities such as Marlborough, Sudbury, Framingham, Andover, Hopkinton, Bolton, Wayland, Maynard, and Westford. The company works with solar financing partners to make systems accessible to average homeowners.

The Reeses started the business to deliver integrity and quality in solar installation, emphasizing owner involvement, low-pressure sales (no dedicated salespeople), and post-installation support to ensure investments outperform. Their nationally recognized track record includes 13 consecutive years on Solar Power World's Top Solar Contractors list.

name: Brilliant Solar
old_description: At Brilliant Solar, we've been powering homes and businesses with clean, renewable energy since 2017. Our recent installations highlight the latest in solar technology, helping customers save on energy costs and reduce their carbon footprint. Check out our latest projects and see how Brilliant Solar can bring sustainable energy to your property!
about:
Brilliant Solar, operating as Brilliant Installations, is based in Toms River, New Jersey. The company was founded in 2017 by Michael Piompino, a solar industry veteran who had been working in the field since 2010. Piompino launched the business to provide end-to-end solar solutions for homeowners and businesses in the region.

The firm specializes in turnkey solar installations, including rooftop and ground-mount arrays, and supplements that work with in-house roofing, tree removal, and electrical services. Its NABCEP-certified installers and electricians handle everything from site assessment and engineering through permitting, installation, and final inspection. The company also arranges financing and backs its systems with production guarantees and bumper-to-bumper warranties. The team has grown to roughly 80 employees and serves more than 80 markets across the Northeast.

Brilliant Solar serves residential and commercial customers looking to reduce electricity costs and carbon emissions. Typical projects range from single-family homes in New Jersey and Pennsylvania to small-business facilities. The company partners with solar-panel manufacturers and battery suppliers such as Tesla to deliver complete energy systems.

Piompino started the company to bring a customer-first, data-driven approach to an industry he felt was often opaque. The firm emphasizes transparent pricing, rapid deployment—with 90 percent of systems operational within 90 days—and ongoing performance monitoring to ensure production targets are met.

name: Brooks Molds
old_description: Welcome to Brooks Molds. We specialize in the tooling and manufacturing of molds for the cast polymer industry, including cultured marble, Tyvarian and solid surface molds. For over 20 years, we’ve been making molds that are unmatched in performance and unrivaled in craftsmanship, skillfully built with our hands just as much as with our hearts and our minds.  Our cast polymer fiberglass molds are built with quality materials and durable bracing systems, and we made our name producing durable standard and custom molds with industry-leading design and construction. We exceptionally specialize in customizing solutions for your unique mold needs. We will exceed your expectations, and you can count on peace of mind, productivity and innovation when you use our molds.
about:
Brooks Molds operates from Elmore, Alabama, where it has been a family-owned and operated business since 1999. The company traces its roots to 1984, when Bobby Brooks joined the mold and prototype department at Mortar Creek Plastics in Elmore. He advanced to shop supervisor and master pattern maker before launching Brooks Molds in 1999. His son Timothy now works alongside him, continuing the family operation.

The shop specializes in tooling and manufacturing molds for the cast polymer industry, serving producers of cultured marble, Tyvarian, and solid surface materials. Every mold is built by hand layup using fiberglass and composite resins, with each step monitored by the owners. The product line includes standard and custom bowls, wall panels, vanity tops, shower pans, shower niches, trim molds, and a range of custom patterns. The company maintains a master inventory of patterns and can handle both standard and custom design-and-build projects.

Customers are primarily cast polymer manufacturers and fabricators across the United States. Testimonials reference companies such as Majestic Kitchen & Bath, Micalline LLC, Amarillo Marble, Elite Marble, The Bath Collection, Carstin Brands, Easton Industries, Custom Bath Products, St. Louis Marble Company, Custom Designer Surface, Hall Marble, and BSWB Inc. These clients use Brooks molds in daily production of countertops, bath fixtures, and wall panels.

The company emphasizes durability and long service life, citing heavy-duty bracing systems, immaculate care of master patterns, and the use of what it describes as the industry's most effective materials. The goal is to reduce downtime from mold repairs and to deliver molds that stay in peak condition for years. Owners Bobby and Timothy Brooks oversee every build, a practice they say ensures consistent quality and custom solutions for unique mold needs.
